scenario: A cloud-gaming industry note covers only platforms that survive three years and post MAU growth above 50%. Analysts use the note's average growth to estimate typical platform growth.

data.description: Only surviving platforms with growth above 50 percentage points are included. Growth is Normal with sigma 20 percentage points.

question: Estimate (a) the true mean growth mu across all platforms and (b) the fraction of platforms featured.
naive_answer: Typical growth is about 60.5 percentage points because that is the note's average.
naive_trap: The note includes only upper-tail survivors.
python_verification:
from scipy.optimize import brentq
from scipy.stats import norm
def eq(mu): a=(50-mu)/20; return mu+20*norm.pdf(a)/norm.sf(a)-60.50
mu=brentq(eq,-100,49.99)
frac=norm.sf((50-mu)/20)
assert abs(mu-30)<2 and abs(frac-0.1587)<0.005
